learner_operation: For each offered coordinate set, mentally zero exactly those entries, locate each remaining row leading entry, check strictly increasing leading columns and bottom-only zero rows; select the unique successful offered operation.

fixed_features.feature: Ordinary 4x4 integer matrix, five radio options, one successful offered operation
fixed_features.justification: All 15 source practice questions have this moderate response shape and workload.

fixed_features.feature: Entry replacement by zero, strictly rightward leading entries, bottom-only zero rows
fixed_features.justification: Tutorials 3148 and 3896 define the necessary operation and echelon conditions. Unit pivots or row arithmetic are not required.

fixed_features.feature: Fresh-bank option lengths and already-zero-coordinate counts are equal within each bank
fixed_features.justification: This removes easy length/no-op cues while retaining source replay banks separately. It does not justify centering distractors around the keyed coordinate set.

answer_roles.role: Erased entries versus surviving leading entries
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change zero structure or offered operation while preserving echelon criterion and workload.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh controls, 15 source profiles, and fixed-bank counterfactual show different correct coordinates, surviving pivots and zero rows.

answer_roles.role: Correct operation within the answer bank
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Already-zero entries and redundant erasures are valid when the offered bank has one successful operation; no global minimum requirement.
answer_roles.observed: Both prior exclusions repaired. New distractor neighborhood is defined around the keyed set in lexicographic order, leaking statistical information about its rank.

answer_roles.role: Displayed correct position and coordinate ordering rank
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Radio placement and incidental coordinate-order rank must not replace echelon reasoning.
answer_roles.observed: UI positions vary; lexicographic-median action succeeds 31/96 held-out controls and 24/64 after actual CLI rejection plus delivery, against 0.2 baseline.

coverage.case: Complete original profiles and already-zero distractor
coverage.result: All 15 profiles preserve all five coordinate sets and source key. q-73149 retains already-zero a21 in an incorrect offered operation.

coverage.case: Nonminimum but sole valid offered operation
coverage.result: q-42008 matrix accepts a12,a21,a43, while unoffered a21,a43 also works. Global minimum is no longer required.

counterfactuals.change: With the bank fixed, set a21 from 2 to 0 and a31 from 0 to 2 in the q-42008 matrix.
counterfactuals.expected: Key switches from {a21,a43} to {a31,a43}; matrix, worked transformation and grading follow the change.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent exact echelon predicate gives key indices 0 -> 1. Native grader accepts new key and rejects old key. Actual UI renders changed entries and solution.
counterfactuals.justification: The first nonzero column in the affected rows determines whether an erasure is needed; this is precisely tutorial 3148/3896 reasoning.

counterfactuals.change: Keep q-42008 matrix and four distractors fixed; replace successful {a21,a43} option with redundant {a12,a21,a43}.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt matrix stays fixed and solution/grader follow the new offered operation; an unoffered smaller operation must not cause rejection.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact regression, independent predicate and native grader pass; rendered nonminimum record shows a12 erased along with a21 and a43.
counterfactuals.justification: Source asks which offered operation works, not global minimization. Redundant erasure of a12 preserves the first-row leading entry.

counterfactuals.change: Change a11 from 1 to -2 in the before matrix, with bank fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Same coordinate answer, different visible nonzero magnitude in prompt and worked matrices.
counterfactuals.observed: Key remains index 0; all five grader outcomes preserved; actual rendered matrix and worked transformation show -2.
counterfactuals.justification: Nonzero sign and magnitude do not change leading-column or zero-row order.

stages_examined: generator source profiles, validation, catalogue and new bank construction
shared publisher normalization and stable identities
native learner selection rule and reused matching-binding captured-pool model
delivery.result: Actual CLI consumes 77 candidates, rejects 13 repeated semantic fingerprints, and returns 64; all survive shared delivery, and median cue wins 24/64. All 96 single-call controls and five batch items also survive. Exact-batch median wins 2/5: no separate universal batch shortcut or batch-selection failure established. Difficulty-first uniform-within-band selection retains cue rates in expectation if all moderate records are eligible; learner history and default lowest-ID selection can alter the subset.

limitations: Statistical leakage is demonstrated; median does not answer every item.
Initial 24-seed sample motivated the fresh 96-seed control; exact construction law supports the independent control result.
No finite audit excludes every possible cue.
Captured inventory basis 5354 is fixed. Future inventory, allocated entity IDs, policy weights and learner history are unavailable; selection conclusions are conditional.

Five non-source stored candidates were inspected and explicit reconstruction attempted, but matching identity/generation metadata was not reproduced. Empty affected-inventory.json is not verified absence of affected stored content.
Canonical example lacks an answer bank; only its stated transformation can be verified.
